simple.meaning: יְגַר שַׂהֲדוּתָא (Yᵉgar Sahădûwthâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jegar-Sahadutha , a cairn East of the Jordan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יְגַר שַׂהֲדוּתָא (H3026) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 31:47, with occurrences in Genesis.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְגַר שַׂהֲדוּתָא (H3026) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יְגַר שַׂהֲדוּתָא (H3026) before moving outward to related references.
